skill.summary: Create and manage test payment links including one-time, recurring, plans, multi-product, custom, pay-what-you-want, and discount options.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of upload-skill.

- Create and manage test payment links with support for one-time, recurring, custom plans, and multiple products.
- Strict input validation, error handling, and security rules defined.
- Sandbox/test environment only; no real payment processing occurs.
- Extensive link configuration and advanced feature options included.
- Output contract: Always return raw, structured JSON without commentary.
- Supports webhook management, extensibility, and testing guidelines.
